question:
Read the given sentence carefully. Change the meaning of the sentence by replacing the underlined word with its ANTONYM from the following options.

I have keen interest in reading the mind of those students who are __boisterous__ at home but on their best behaviour at school.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"boisterous"** means noisy, energetic, and cheerful; rowdy. (उल्लासपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The children were** boisterous** as they played in the park.
 
 
 
• **"Placid" **refers to something that is not easily upset or excited; calm and peaceful. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **The lake was **placid** and serene, perfect for a quiet afternoon.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'boisterous' **is **'placid'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clamorous **(कोलाहलपूर्ण): Making a loud and confused noise.

 
 
• **Example:** The clamorous crowd demanded to be heard.
 
 
 
• **Raucous **(कर्कश): Making or constituting a disturbingly harsh and loud noise.
 
 
• **Example: **The raucous laughter from the party next door kept me awake all night.
 
 
 
• **Frothing** (झागयुक्त): Forming or containing a rising or overflowing mass of small bubbles.
 
 
• **Example:** The frothing waves crashed against the shore.
 
 

3c:Tb1a,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**</p&
